answer.rationale: p99 latency is climbing on the write path during peak settlement traffic. The release cannot be rolled back due to compliance constraints. Routing read queries to replicas (memory_b5) reduced dashboard load and recovered transactional write latency the same day without requiring capacity provisioning or rollback. This preserves the mandatory security patch while offloading read pressure from the primary, freeing write capacity during the critical settlement peak. Circuit breakers (memory_b4) would only fail fast but wouldn't increase capacity. Regional failover (memory_b2) risks settlement atomicity during peak writes. Add capacity is slower. Route read replicas is the fastest safe path that respects the compliance constraint.
